changelog:
✨ New Features
• Debugging: Block/force offline feature flags
• GmsCore support: Support video/audio casting to other devices (Requires latest MicroG-RE)
• Captions: Add bilingual captions with synchronized blocks
• Captions: Prefer uploaded bilingual subtitles
• Copy text: Add option to select text of descriptions and posts
• Downloads: Export in-app videos to device storage
• Feed card layout: Add "Default" to "Feed card layout", which keeps the layout that the server sends
• Feed video actions: Watch later button shows a check mark if the video is saved, and removes the video when tapped
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide comments preview" to "Post buttons"
• Hide layout components: Add "Post buttons" settings to choose the layout of the post buttons and hide them
• Minimal miniplayer: Add "Docked miniplayer" setting
• Minimal miniplayer: Add "Expand with swipe up" setting
• Navigation bar: Add "Enable glass navigation bar" setting
• Navigation bar: Add "Glass navigation bar size" setting, and fit the glass navigation bar to its buttons
• Navigation bar: Add "Navigation buttons order" and "Toolbar buttons order" settings
• Navigation bar: Add "Show Watch later button" setting
• Navigation bar: Added a Glass navigation bar lit rim
• Niconico comments: Add "Display area" setting
• Niconico comments: Add "Max refresh rate" setting
• Niconico comments: Add "Show timed comments with chat replay" setting
• Niconico comments: Add reset button to quick settings
• Niconico comments: Add video type selection
• Niconico comments: Show timed comments on videos without a chat
• Restore old video action bar: Add the "Classic Two-Rows" layout to "Video action bar layout", and remove "Enable tablet layout in player"
• Restore old video action bar: Replace the setting with "Video action bar layout", with the Default, Classic and Minimal layouts
• Series tracking: Add "Mark watched when moving to the next episode" setting
• Swipe controls: Add swipe to seek
• Theme: Add setting to configure 'Glow' splash screen duration, and allow tapping to skip animation
• Translate live chat: Add DeepL provider and fix Google rate limiting issue
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide GIF button" and "Hide GIFs and images" comment settings
• Add Change PiP actions patch
• Add Snackbar patch
• Add Translate live chat patch
• Remove the new setting dot once the setting is opened or changed
• Show at most one Morphe snackbar message each second

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio, thumbnail and subtitle downloader with Save to device and offline SponsorBlock
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Spoof video streams: Do not block get_watch, initplayback, or Onesie requests
• Spoof video streams: Do not fetch streams again if a fetch for the same video is in progress
• Spoof video streams: Video opened from the search results can load forever when another video is fetched at the same time
• Save to Watch later: Implement the refinements for Watch Later screen
• Change start page: Top bar and navigation bar show the default buttons for 20 seconds without a cached guide
• Disable fullscreen gestures: Pinch-to-zoom does not work in Shorts
• Downloads: App can crash when downloading Short in-app
• Downloads: Captions of in-app downloads show escaped punctuation
• Downloads: Playback speed is unavailable for in-app downloads
• Downloads: Use default export folder if the picked folder is missing
• Feed card layout: "getUri failure" toast and cards not converted while the app rewrites its template cache
• Feed card layout: Cards lose their rounded corners when scrolled back into view, and their corners and padding don't match the cards after the display density changes
• Feed card layout: Cards lose their rounded corners while scrolling and their margin doubles once fully shown
• Feed card layout: Cards of the watch page grid on tablets have square corners
• Feed card layout: Classic layout does not apply to mixes, playlists and posts
• Feed card layout: Comment button of the cards opens the video instead of only the comments panel
• Feed card layout: Feed videos disappear and come back on scroll when the app drops the cached template version
• Feed card layout: Feed videos have no save items in the menu when the cards with a save button are converted to the classic layout
• Feed card layout: Playlists converted to cards have no background below the thumbnail
• Feed card layout: Playlists have no background below the thumbnail with the new server layout of the cards
• Feed card layout: Server experiments of the account change the converted cards, such as removing their menu button
• Feed video actions: Inline watch later button performClick logic superseeded by direct app command
• Feed video actions: Tap and hold on the Watch later button can show the video menu instead of the Save to playlist panel
• Feed view count: Badge is shown when the text below the title already shows the view count
• Feed view count: Badge of a card that enters from the bottom is hidden between the loading spinner and the view count, when the view count is on a row below the channel
• Feed view count: Badge of a vertical thumbnail is in the middle of the thumbnail until the title row is drawn
• Feed view count: Loading spinner is shown on cards whose title row is not drawn yet, such as long thumbnails
• Feed view count: View count of the previous video is shown for a moment when a list reuses a card, such as in the notifications
• Force fullscreen landscape: Setting is shown on large screens with Android 16 and later, which ignore the orientation it requests
• GmsCore Support: Allow casting to audio only devices
• Hide ads: Ads are shown in the Shorts feed when a channel is in the ad whitelist
• Hide layout components: "Hide Explore button" not working in incognito mode
• Hide layout components: Comment box, composer and reply buttons open the channel guidelines sheet with "Hide Community Guidelines"
• Hide layout components: Downloads item of the You tab cannot be hidden
• Hide layout components: Filtered download item of the feed flyout menu appears until its download state is loaded
• Hide layout components: Pages of the Explore menu, such as Movies and Memberships, are empty or miss their shelves with "Hide horizontal shelves"
• Hide layout components: Prevent shelves from hiding on Charts, Memberships, and Playables pages
• Hide player flyout menu components: Fix player flyout menu items not hiding
• Hide video action buttons: "Hide Subscribe button" and "Hide channel and Subscribe button" don't hide the channel bar above the action bar
• Minimal miniplayer: Bar is black beside the video while the player collapses in the light theme
• Minimal miniplayer: Bar keeps a larger gap above the snackbar than the snackbar keeps above the navigation bar
• Minimal miniplayer: Snackbar covers the bar instead of moving it up like the default miniplayer
• Morphe snackbar: Increased snackbar queue timeout to 5 seconds
• Navigation bar: Black band around the glass navigation bar on Android 11 and older, and with Hide status bar before Android 15
• Navigation bar: Black band behind the translucent or glass navigation bar with Hide status bar
• Navigation bar: Glass navigation bar has the wrong height with 3-button navigation
• Navigation bar: Glass navigation bar is too tall with layout updates disabled
• Navigation bar: Glass navigation bar is white around the capsule in the Shorts player with the light theme
• Navigation bar: Glass navigation bar is wider than its buttons, so the first and the last button are not aligned with the ends of the bar
• Navigation bar: Glass navigation bar size preview draws the labels over the icons when the labels are hidden, and shows placeholders instead of the button icons
• Navigation bar: Swap create with notifications button does not change the toolbar of the You tab
• Navigation bar: Swiping the miniplayer does not cancel autoplay with Disable auto hide navigation bar
• Navigation bar: Video button of the create button in the channel page toolbar does nothing
• Niconico comments: Keep a high refresh rate while comments move
• Niconico comments: Make quick settings scrollable in landscape
• Niconico comments: Move comments smoothly before the first video state is reported
• Playback speed: Holding a Short does not play it at 2.0x when a default Shorts speed is set
• Playback speed: Holding a Short does not play it at the custom tap and hold speed when a default Shorts speed is set
• Playback speed: Pitch presets can set an out of range pitch, speed icon shows without pitch controls
• Premium-style queue: Fix dragging videos to the end
• Remove background playback restrictions: Video does not resume when a Short opened over it is closed
• Restore original titles: Update titles during background playback
• Save to Watch later: Item is missing from the flyout menus without a save item, such as the main feed
• Search comments: Improved the check of the comments panels
• Search comments: Search button wasn't shown in the post comments panel
• Seekbar: Shorts seekbar disappears after opening Shorts again or after the settings
• Seekbar: Videos with their own seekbar style show an image as the seekbar handle and ignore the seekbar color
• Series tracking: Thumbnails reload while a video plays
• Settings: New setting dot not displayed correctly on RTL languages
• Skip live Shorts: A live stream opened in the regular player skips the Short behind it
• Swipe controls: Fix double tap to skip chapters
• Theme: App crashes on launch with Android 8.0 when the device uses a night configuration and the app uses the light theme
• Theme: Status bar shows white icons on the light theme colors other than white
• Translate posts: Patch may crash on devices older than Android 10
• Video quality: Quality selected for a regular video in the miniplayer is lost after opening Shorts
• App crashes at launch without the Theme patch
• Channel whitelist and AiSList report items are missing from the Shorts player flyout menu
• Consolidate "Hide cast button" into a single setting
• Crash on Android 12 when closing a settings screen with a new setting
• Fix delayed Subscriptions header on 21.28 & 21.30
• Flyout menu items can run the action of another item, such as Save to playlist adding the video to the queue
• Flyout menus are polled every 10 ms on the main thread, even if a menu is never shown
• Home can be rendered with RenderNext, which the Litho filters and hooks don't see
• Player flyout menu components do not hide
• Small comments card is shown below the player time bar
• Snackbars are shown with an empty space above the navigation bar, as high as the system navigation buttons
• Update experimental target version name
• Watch page action buttons and videos disappear or stay over the list after scrolling while the page loads
• Theme: Menus use the dark color #0F0F0F of the Original variant
• Save to device: Footer of the quality picker is cut off in landscape and with large font sizes
